title: Running the Thermo Scientific Arktik Thermal Cycler
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.in5cdg6
materials: Highlight a folder and press OPEN (F1)
Highlight the protocol and press OPEN again

steps.title: Create a New Protocol
steps.instruction: Initialize a new PCR temperature cycling routine from the main screen.

substeps.instruction: Press NEW from the main screen to display the DEFAULT protocol.

steps.title: Edit Protocol Temperature Steps
steps.instruction: Modify the temperature cycling routine using the cursor and function keys.

substeps.instruction: Toggle between different steps using the cursor keys.
Press ADD (F1) to add a temperature step to the left of the current position.
Press DELETE (F2) to delete a highlighted temperature step.

steps.title: Configure Advanced Temperature Options
steps.instruction: Add advanced parameters by pressing OPTION (F3) and following the on-screen instructions.

substeps.instruction: Press INC (F1) to add or subtract a temperature increment.
Press EXT (F2) to add or subtract a time extension.
Press RAMP (F3) to slow the ramp rate (input range: 0.1 - 0.4 degrees C/sec).
Press GRAD (F4) to set a gradient.
Press SAVE (F5) to save the protocol, or press BACK (F4) to exit without saving.

steps.title: Initiate Protocol Run
steps.instruction: Start the selected protocol and confirm execution.

steps.title: Configure Run Mode and Vessel
steps.instruction: Specify the operational mode and vessel type for the run.

substeps.instruction: Specify the mode by selecting SAMPLE (F4) (recommended for most protocols) or BLOCK (F5).
Specify the vessel type by selecting UTW (F4) or COMMON (F5).
Press YES (F4) to run the protocol.
